root: ^...What era is this promotional video from, an antique? And who painted these!! It’s simply slander! Slander! Do I, White Spirit Warden, look this ugly? Black, what do you say!!
^I knew I couldn’t count on you! Rookie boss, What do you say?
^The painting is indeed a bit unbearable.

c-0: ^No! Boss! You’ve also been led astray by Black!
c-1: ^Right, right! I am suave and handsome...
g-0: ^However, this back-and-forth process is indeed accurate.
^Hmm. The origins of the mysterious cases team are quite clear.
^How is it clear! A person as important as me hasn't even appeared!
^I am directly assigned by the King of Netherworld, Qin Guang, to assist the new arbiter!
^Anyway, our team’s duty is to investigate those special cases and unravel the ghosts' obsessions! In the end—judgment! Judgment!
^By the way! Newcomer! This is the handbook given to you by Qin Guang King; it has more detailed information!
^That old... the lord's book is long and tedious; it's better to just follow Black through the process.
^Let me quietly tell the boss, Black rehearsed for this process guide until the middle of the night!
^Let's leave it to the arbiter to decide.
